issues.description: Calling convention inconsistency for set_pixel: The problem statement requires set_pixel to receive x in EAX, y in EBX, RGB in ECX and to not modify any registers except EAX. The reference solution's set_pixel saves/restores EBX, ESI and EDX but unconditionally modifies EDI via "or edi, edi" without saving/restoring it, and also uses EDI as an implicit input (alpha/format flag) even though neither the statement nor the template define EDI as a parameter. This contradicts the specified interface and makes the solution behavior depend on an undefined register value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make set_pixel independent of EDI and preserve all registers except EAX (per specification): remove the EDI-based alpha check and always compute the byte offset for 32bpp (x*4 and y*7680) using a scratch register that is saved/restored. Alternatively, if an additional format/alpha flag is intended, explicitly document it (e.g., EDI as input) and ensure main initializes it before calling set_pixel, and update the 'only EAX may be modified' rule accordingly.
